protocol.purpose: Prospectively test a controller selected on 11 disjoint development routes: permit one online LLM-guided reveal, then continue with deterministic same-start target-only GP-UCB from all accumulated observations.
protocol.primary_estimand: Equal-route-weighted mean of within-route mean best-so-far AUC deltas for the bounded-authority controller versus the matched same-initial target-only GP-UCB comparator.
protocol.primary_success_rule: The two-sided hierarchical bootstrap 95% confidence interval for the primary estimand must lie entirely above zero after all 180 declared trajectories complete.
secondary_endpoints: route-level win, tie, and loss counts
one-round LLM participation, GP override, critic revision, source-active, and token-use rates
target-GP fallback rounds, LLM rounds saved, and nominal proposer/critic calls avoided
protocol.multiplicity: Route-level two-sided sign-test p-values are adjusted with Benjamini-Hochberg. These are secondary analyses.
protocol.partial_result_policy: Partial execution is operational evidence only. Confirmatory inference is disabled until every declared route has every declared trajectory.
protocol.stopping_rule: No optional stopping, route removal, or controller change based on interim outcomes. Infrastructure failures remain in the audit tree and may be retried only under the frozen retry policy.
protocol.route_selection_note: The six routes are disjoint from the 11 routes used to choose the controller. They are not newly discovered task families: one earlier retrospective trajectory per route was inspected during development.
protocol.claim_boundary: New stochastic trajectories are prospective with respect to the frozen controller, but the route identities and earlier outcomes were already known. This is an internal route-disjoint repeated confirmation, not external-task or wet-lab validation.

retry_policy.retryable_failures: HTTP 408/409/425/429/5xx, rate or cost caps, timeouts, DNS failures, and connection interruptions.
retry_policy.claim_policy: A confirmatory decision is disabled unless all 180 declared trajectories complete successfully. Every failed attempt remains in the audit tree.

calibration_gate.policy_provenance: Selected using only the 11-route training panel in configs/online_llm_gate_selection_audit_v1.json; no evaluation-route metric enters selection.
calibration_gate.fallback_policy: After one online proposer/critic decision and reveal, make no later LLM request. Execute deterministic target-only GP-UCB rank one from every observation accumulated so far.
